name: Stone barn
description: Norman stone barn, 16 x 9 m and 5 m to the eaves: wide double cart doors and a side door, ventilation slits used as loopholes, a hay loft over the east third reached by a timber stair, with an open pitching door in the gable looking out over the fields. Farm cart, hay, stalls. B2: a dressed cart arch over the cart doors, three buttresses with sloped set-offs on the rear wall, chamfered plinth, bevelled quoins, ivy on the west gable and rear.
